description: This file provides an implementation of the gettimeofday function for Windows platforms, since it is typically available on POSIX systems. It interfaces with Windows API functions to retrieve system time and converts it into the POSIX timeval structure format, also handling timezone information.

methods.name: int gettimeofday(struct timeval * tv,struct timezone * tz)
methods.description: Custom implementation of gettimeofday function for Windows, retrieves the current system time and populates timeval and timezone structures if provided.
